mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and producing positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of sustained FEDFUNDS decline are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 4.0% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative 20-day forward returns as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls by more than 0.5% in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.3% in the same month, it signals a weakening economy, producing negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (INDPRO fall and UNRATE rise) fails to produce negative returns in more than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, compressing equity valuations and producing negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 60% of high inflation periods, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1200 thousand units in a month, it signals a weakening housing market and reduced consumer confidence, producing negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 in a month, it signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, producing negative 5-day forward returns as investors react to immediate economic weakness.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 1-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When residential fixed investment (RSAFS) falls below 480000 million dollars and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) rises above 2.5%, it signals a weakening economy with high inflation, producing negative 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (RSAFS < 480000 and CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) fails to produce negative returns in more than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 3.0% in a single month, it signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative 20-day forward returns as investors anticipate reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
